description: List Facade components and blocks (animated React + Tailwind sections for local business, real estate and agency sites). Filter by kind, category, tier or a text query. All filters are optional; without any filter every item is returned.

category.description: Registry category, case-insensitive. One of: Buttons, Cards, Conversion, Data, Feedback, Forms, Hero, Layout, Local business, Media, Navigation, Real estate, Sections, Text.

kind.description: 'component' for single UI pieces (badges, cards, inputs), 'block' for full page sections (hero, pricing, FAQ).

query.description: Free text matched against name, title, description and tags, e.g. 'pricing', 'hero', 'booking'.

tier.description: 'free' for MIT licensed items anyone can install, 'pro' for items that need a license key.

name: list_components
title: List Facade components
